english: Incomprehensible. Incomprehensible. Error: incomprehensible.
Why can't you get it~?\nIt's fun! Those girls' powers!
Why do humans try to use the power\nof IS and the Angel's Tears for destruction?
Humans' operational concepts are wrong.\nThey fail to draw out\nthe power's potential.
Why do they not build\nrational systems utilizing\nthat energy?
That's what Mii finds fun about them! Humans!
Humans use power wrong.\nIncomprehensible! Incomprehensible!
Being wrong is what makes it good!\nIt's more fun that way~!
Setting that aside, please decide\non Gustav's deployment plan.
Hmm, the Angel's Tears\nare at Black Fund HQ, right?
It is a trifling weapon of destruction made by humans.\nI believe we have no need of it, though.
That's not true.\nFiring Gustav bang-bang is\nthe most fun of all!
But just firing it is boring.\nWe've got to use it in a fun way!
Where shall we set the target?
Hmm... how about here?\nSt. Cherine Academy♪
Understood. Proceeding with the firing plan at once.
W-w-wait a minute!!\nFiring it right away is boring,\nso let's play a little~.
Incomprehensible. I recommend immediate attack.
Like I said, it's not about the result.\nFun is about the pro-cess, the pro-cess.\nPro-cess.
The process, you mean.
That's it!\nYou always skip the process, Kei-chan.\nWell, that's why Mii's here~.
I will follow Mii's instructions.
Then bring me paper, ink, and a brush!
??? ...Incomprehensible.
//fade to black\n//Background: St. Cherine Academy classroom
Huh!? Tesla and Nine\ncame from Italy!?
Yes. Because of my father's... work,\nwe traveled to many countries.
Hey hey, Kurumi-chan.\nItaly's the spaghetti country, right?
Honestly, is food all you think about?\nThere are other famous things, you know?\nThe Mouth of Truth, the Leaning Tower of Pisa...
Whaaat!? There's a pizza tower!?
Haruka-san, not pizza — Pisa.\nIt's a tower in a city called Pisa.
Ehehe, right.\nIf a pizza were a tower,\nthe birds would eat it.
(...Didn't she mix it up\nwith pizza before, too...?)
(Haruka likes pizza...?)
Honestly, keeping up with Haruka\nthrows off my rhythm.
Haruka marches to her own beat. Ahaha!
//Dejiko rushes back into the room from outside,\ncarrying a letter of challenge.
Big trouble, nyo!!
What's wrong, out of the blue like this?
This arrived, nyo!
Chal... lenge letter...\nA letter of challenge!?\nSomeone's prank?
Mion-san, you could read that?\nThe handwriting's awful!
No — thanks to that, I have a pretty good\nidea who wrote it.
Um, do you recognize\nthis handwriting?
No... most likely Mii's doing.
Let's see, I'll read it.
//Mion takes the letter of challenge from Dejiko and reads its contents.
I challenge you all to a duel.\nIf you beat Mii and Kei-chan within the time limit,\nI'll give you the Angel's Tears.
If time runs out,\nSt. Cherine Academy goes ZUKYUN♪\n...it says.
Does "zukyun" mean\nfiring Gustav?
Most likely.
Nooo! That's absolutely not okay!
(Fine calligraphy is nice, but bad handwriting\nhas its own charm.)
(Isn't it just hard to read and annoying?)
([CLAUDE], if men like you were\nthe only men in this world,\nwomen everywhere would lose their cuteness.)
(I'm just saying normal things?)
(Humans aren't machines.\nChasing convenience alone loses richness.\nPlease don't forget that.)
(Richness...)
From the wording, the Angel's Tears\nare already in Mii-san's hands?
This also tells us it was Mii,\nnot Kei, who moved.
At this point we have no choice\nbut to storm Black Fund HQ directly.
This is the worst-case pattern, desu~...
It's the hottest development ever, but\nit looks rough...\nfufu, though I might kinda like it?
Now that it's decided, let's move!\nEveryone, assemble~!
//fade to black\n//Background: harbor warehouse
Black Fund HQ is close!
Stooop! Hey, you guys~\nwhere are you off to~?
Meeean! I sent a letter of challenge\nand you ignored it!
So you've shown yourself!
Here I am! It's Mii!\nKei-chan's here too!
Area scan: no anomalies.
Well, look who showed up!\nThanks for the warm welcome!
Wrong! You didn't come to the duel spot,\nso I came to check!
Duel spot?
Not Black Fund HQ?
Nooo!\nNot some drab place like that...!
The challenge letter I read\ndidn't say where?
Hwuh?
Mii, explain.
Tehe, looks like I forgot to write it!
Incomprehensible!
Their sync rate is off the charts, nyo!!
Eh, whatever! Let's do it here! Duel!
Wow, decided on a whim!
You're always like that too.\nAnyway, we'll intercept!!
//Battle map: harbor warehouse\n//Player units, Mii, Kei, grunts deployed.
Ahaha! A duel!
Never seen such a casual duel!
Mii's all about bright and fun.\nFighting with a scary face? No way.
That attitude of yours is scarier.
As already conveyed,\nif you cannot defeat us within 5 turns,\nwe will fire Gustav.
5 turns is too short, nyo!\nIt should be longer, nyo!
Okay, then let's change it to within 4 turns!
It got one turn shorter, nyo!?
That's 'cause you said something unnecessary, nyu.\nReflect, nyu!
I request a change to within 6 turns, nyo!
Denied.
That's so mean, nyo!!
Now, let the fun duel begin!
//Battle start.\n//Talk event when someone engages Mii.
Hey hey, no time left?\nDo your best~!
You call this a duel...!?
Don't like this vibe?\nOh, but Tsubacchi loves\ncoughing up blood and stuff, right?
I merely know the weight of the word "duel."\nAnd that it shouldn't be spoken lightly.
You'd get along with Kei-chan!
Not a chance.
//Talk event when someone engages Kei.
Huh? You seem unmotivated?
In this battle, the only thing with meaning\nis the passage of time.\nNothing else has any meaning.
I see — once the time limit hits it's over,\nso there's no point fighting seriously?
You won't even answer!!\nTalk about power-saving mode!
//Event triggers again after defeating Mii and Kei, or after 4 turns.
Time limit expired.\nIt is time to fire Gustav.
Aw, too bad! Time's up~!
Is it no good, nyo!?
Bzzt! Kei-chan, you can fire!
Understood. Confirming remote-operation data link.\nTarget: St. Cherine Academy.\nGustav firing in 3 seconds.
Stoooop!!
Please! Stop!
Ahaha! Wanna try dogeza?\nWon't stop me though!
2 seconds... 1 second...
Gustav, fiiire!! Zukyun!
//But nothing happens; everyone is dumbfounded.
Huh...?\nKei-chan, what's going on?
Error! Error!
...Could it be\nFather stopped the firing...?
Nope.
Huh?
//Black Haruka, Aoi, and Kurumi appear.
...Malice and despair, a hundred shots, a hundred hits.
...Destroying everyone's smiles.
Wicked-thief angel Twin Angel.
It's the black Twin Angel!!
I'll be taking this.
That's... the Angel's Tears!!
Did you... save us?
Who knows?
Well then, farewell.
//Black Haruka, Aoi, and Kurumi leave.
They vanished...!?
What does this mean...?
Could it be we're saved?
Ahahahaha!\nWhat is this? What IS this?\nSo fun! Ahahahahaha!!
What's so funny!?\nAren't they your allies?
Incomprehensible. Mii, revise the mission.
Yeah~...
Let's go home!
Huh!?
Ahahahaha!\nSee ya! Byebye!
//Mii vanishes.
She really left!?
Mission force-terminated. Understood.
//Kei vanishes.\n//Battle end.\n//Background: harbor warehouse
What was that!?\nThey said "duel" and then just\nlost interest and went home!?
Their own plan got crushed,\nand they're laughing like that... what's wrong with them!?
They're the incomprehensible ones, yes.
Maybe that Mii girl really is\njust treating it all like a game?
Trying to fire a satellite cannon for fun\nis no joke, nyo!
I kinda get it, actually.\nThat girl's so strong,\nshe's probably just bored.
Would you do the same thing, nyu?
No way.\nIf you break something that can't be fixed,\nyou shouldn't break it, right?
It's like she doesn't even get that, or\nshe's beyond it...\nI can't figure that girl out.
Kei's still better.\nShe thinks like a total machine.\nShe's just being dragged around by Mii.
Is that how it is?
What will Tesla-chan and Nine-chan\ndo from here?
We can't stop until we've taken back\nthe Angel's Tears\nand neutralized Gustav.
//Event CG: Kurumi going dere
Tesla, Nine... it seems\nI really misunderstood you two.
Hazuki-san?
Honestly, I've still got a long way to go.\nNo matter what happened in the past,\nI couldn't bring myself to trust...
Here you are, admitting your past mistakes\nand facing the problem at hand, while I...\nI'm utterly pathetic.
It's fine.\nI'm a suspicious person too.\nI think Hazuki-san's attitude was only natural.
I... don't care anymore.
Thanks...
//Event CG off.
So, what now?\nThe Angel's Tears got taken\nby the black Twin Angel.
Even if we search, we've got no idea\nwhere those black ones\nare hiding.
At least the Angel's Tears are\naway from Gustav now.
Yes. We still have to take it back, but\nit's way better than leaving\nthe world in danger!
I wonder how Mii and Kei will move next?
Trying to predict what brats think\nis a waste of time, nyo.
Coming from Dejiko-chan, that's convincing.
Maybe the team that went to IS Academy\nfound something new?
True, regrouping once might be good.
Dejiko thinks we should regroup\nin Akihabara, nyo!
W-wow, Akihabara... b-but! The other day,\ndidn't you just take me there...?
Don't be so stiff about it, nyo!
Well, we're just regrouping. It's fine, no?
All riiight, nyo!!
What are you scheming, nyu?\nSomething bad again, nyu?
No, nyo!\nDejiko is thinking about something\nvery, very important, nyo!
Something important... I see!\nThen we must go to Akihabara!
//END
